home.heroSubtitle: Toolora brings useful tools into one private, fast workspace. Open a tool, process your files locally, and keep moving.
home.trustLine: No sign-up · No upload · Open source

sections.toolsSubtitle: From JSON utilities to Word, Excel, and PDF parsing, everything has one consistent entry point — with more tools on the way.

step1.title: Pick a tool
step1.desc: Choose the tool that fits the task without installing another desktop app.

step2.title: Import or paste
step2.desc: Upload a local file or paste content into the workspace to start.

step3.title: Take the result
step3.desc: Results appear instantly. Copy or download them and continue your work.

items.a: Completely safe. All processing happens in your browser — your JSON is never uploaded to any server.

items.q: How large a JSON file can I handle?
items.a: Multi-megabyte JSON works fine. Heavy parsing runs in a Web Worker so the UI never freezes.

items.q: Do I need to sign up or pay?
items.a: No. Toolora is completely free, open source, and requires no sign-up or limits.
Currently 8 languages: TypeScript, Go, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Rust, C#, and Dart.

footerCta.title: Ready to work with your JSON?
footerCta.subtitle: Free, private, no sign-up. Start now.

fast.title: Blazing fast
fast.desc: Heavy JSON runs in a Web Worker, so multi-megabyte files stay smooth.

private.title: Private by design
private.desc: No accounts, no uploads, no telemetry. Your JSON never leaves the page.

precise.title: Precise errors
precise.desc: Validation pinpoints the exact line and column of any syntax problem.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.body: There is no backend that stores your data. The app is a static front end — JSON is processed entirely on your device.

developers.title: Built for developers
developers.body: Powered by the Monaco editor — the same engine behind VS Code — with proper syntax highlighting and a real keyboard experience.

free.title: Always free
free.body: No paywalls, no usage limits, no ads. Open source under the MIT license.

empty.outputHint: Paste or type JSON on the left, then hit Format, Minify, or Validate.

errors.unexpected_eof: Unexpected end of input — the JSON is truncated or missing a closing bracket/brace.
errors.unexpected_token: Unexpected token — this character is not valid in the current position.
errors.trailing_comma: Expected a property name or '}' — there may be a trailing comma or a missing key.
errors.missing_colon: Expected ':' after a property name — a colon is missing.
errors.control_char: Invalid control character inside a string — unescaped newline/tab?
errors.unquoted_key: Property names must be wrapped in double quotes.
errors.repair_failed: Could not repair automatically — the input has structural issues jsonrepair can't resolve.
